risks.title: Interest rate risk on variable-rate debt
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly mentioned in Item 7A with a quantified impact. Refinancing of the 500M USD Term Loan exposes the company to interest rate fluctuations until end-2027. The Capital category is heavily weighted. The risk is stable vs N-1.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk on international assets
risks.score_rationale: Present in Item 7A with concrete measures. The company holds assets and liabilities in foreign currencies (euro, GBP, etc.) across 25 countries. The portfolio includes significant exposures in Europe (Italy, Spain, Poland, Germany). Central position and not fully hedged.

risks.title: Real estate asset impairment risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk described in Critical Accounting Estimates. Real estate assets (15.5B$ in net investments) are sensitive to projected cash flows. Impairments could be significant if widespread value corrections occur due to changes in leasing or economic conditions.

risks.title: Critical accounting estimates
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Item 1A and Critical Accounting Estimates. Heavily dependent on judgments regarding capitalization rates, market rents, and lease terms. Indirect but systemic impact on acquisition valuations and purchase price allocations.

risks.title: Tenant concentration by sector and geography
risks.score_rationale: Visible in Top 10 concentration representing 18.8% of ABR. The top 10 tenants include Extra Space Storage (2.7%), Apotex (2.2%), Life Time Fitness (2.1%). Recognized as a market risk. Although diversified across 371 tenants, a sector-wide crisis would have an asymmetric impact.

ai_positioning.summary: The company WPC does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report. The information provided focuses on financial aspects, real estate, and management services.
